long_description:
The city’s biggest Desi Fest is here. Indo house, live dhol, pani puri, carrom, taash, free henna, bangles and bindis. Bring the crew.

About this Event

They said you had to fly home to feel this. We brought home to LA.
Introducing Desi Fest. The biggest desi celebration LA has ever seen.
India. Pakistan. Bangladesh. Sri Lanka. Nepal. One day.
Picture this: the dhol drops over Indo house and the whole floor goes up. Pani puri in one hand, free nimbu pani in the other. Free henna drying on your hands. Free bangles stacked to the elbow. You’re losing at carrom to someone you met ten minutes ago. You’re winning at teen patti against your best friend. Photo ops at every turn. Curated vendors from our community.
The first 300 people through the door eat pani puri on us, free, just for pulling up early.
Grew up on this? It’s going to feel like home. Never been to a desi party? Best first time you’ll ever have. Desi, Middle Eastern, or just curious, you’re family here.
Come solo, bring your crew, or make it a date.
Capacity is limited. Tickets are available now.
NO REFUNDS. ALL SALES ARE FINAL.
NO ON SITE PARKING. STREET PARKING ONLY.
UBER / LYFT RECOMMENDED.
